source_fields.formulation: Minimize long-run Bayesian average loss relative to the best currently alive arm in a streaming short-lived high-volume bandit.

assumptions.description: At the start of every calendar round t, a new disjoint cohort A_t of k arms arrives. An arm born at t remains available through t+w inclusive. Thus there are w+1 alive cohorts after initialization and w useful feedback opportunities before its last allocation.
assumptions.scope: The domain stated in this clause.

assumptions.description: Each arm mean is drawn independently from a distribution D on [0,1]. Conditional on all means, rewards are independent Bernoulli draws across arms and plays. The prior density satisfies $c_1\le f(u)\le c_2$ almost everywhere, where $0<c_1\le1\le c_2<\infty$. Arrival identities and times contain no mean information. The parameters w,c_1,c_2 are fixed for the rate statements.
assumptions.scope: The domain stated in this clause.

source_fields.operation: At each round the policy chooses nonnegative integer allocations $\pi_t(a)$ to alive arms, with $\sum_{a\in\mathcal A_t}\pi_t(a)=n$. The entire allocation is measurable before any reward from that round is revealed. All rewards from these n plays are revealed together afterward; no within-round adaptation or stopping is permitted. The values n,k,w,c_1,c_2 are public. The policy may be given D; the upper policy uses only its density bounds, and the lower bound holds even when D is the known uniform prior. The arm means are hidden.

feedback_quality.description: The conditional law and exact response packet are specified in the oracle paragraphs.

operations.query_signature: The query domain and ordering stated in the oracle paragraphs.

source_fields.feasibility: The output is the executed sequence of batch allocations. Exactly n plays must be assigned each round, always to arms that are alive.

source_fields.base_expression: Let $\mu_t^*=\max_{a\in\mathcal A_t}\mu_a$. For a finite evaluation horizon T, $\mathcal L_{n,T}(\pi;D)=(nT)^{-1}\mathbb E_D\sum_{t=1}^T\sum_{a\in\mathcal A_t}\pi_t(a)(\mu_t^*-\mu_a)$. The expectation includes the prior, rewards, and policy randomness. The long-run risk uses $\overline{\mathcal L}_n(\pi;D)=\limsup_{T\to\infty}\mathcal L_{n,T}(\pi;D)$. Define $\mathcal L_n^*(c_1,c_2)=\inf_\pi\sup_{D\in\mathfrak D(c_1,c_2)}\overline{\mathcal L}_n(\pi;D)$, allowing a policy to take D as input. The expectation precedes the limit superior; this is not an expectation-of-limsup criterion.

source_fields.budget: The resource parameters are n plays per calendar round, k arriving arms per round, and lifetime w+1 rounds. There are nT rewards over a finite T-round evaluation. The asymptotic rate sends n to infinity at fixed w,c_1,c_2, with k possibly depending on n; T is sent to infinity inside the long-run performance criterion.
